metadata.proof_method: Lean elaboration, tactic replay and kernel checking. Fixed aesop automatic stage; assisted local lemmas, explicit native theorem application, simp/linarith and exact field algebra. R1 principal capability sets are trusted model inputs; no authentication, ownership-derived authority, or honest-administrator security claim.
